review.notes: CC-BY-SA-4.0 attribution preserved. sharp-edges workflow is portable; allowed-tools does not enforce Codex permissions and optional sharp-edges-analyzer plugin agent is not imported. supply-chain collector reads manifests and fetches registry/advisory/repository metadata; writes cache/reports, can read gh auth token and run pip-audit --no-deps --disable-pip. Inspect before use and approve network disclosure of package names. No collector executed.
review.method: GitHub connector existence check; public GitHub REST metadata+commit+recursive tree; immutable raw file retrieval; static selected-content review. No upstream scripts executed.
